name: Chandrahas
reason: Devotee prince of Kuntala is a genuine person-name; the sword association is secondary, so meaning should lead with the devotee/smile sense.

fix.meaning_en: Moon-like bright smile; also the name of a devout prince of Kuntala.

name: Charuvrat
reason: Well-formed auspicious compound (cāru + vrata), sandhi fine; rare but acceptable.

name: Chidananda
reason: Established spiritual given name; cit + ānanda correct.

name: Lakhan
reason: Accepted vernacular form of Lakshmana, widely used as a given name.

name: Trinath
reason: Traditional Telugu usage; tri + nātha correct, auspicious.

name: Yatish
reason: yati + īśa sandhi correct (yatīśa); recognised name.

name: Umaprasad
reason: Common Bengali devotional name; Uma + prasāda correct.
